angleRead.name: P Slayer
angleRead.text: I'm still trying to process the energy of the crowd as Pablo Almanzar took the mound, the hum of the BART tracks in the distance a reminder that this is Oakland, and we're hungry for a win. I've been feeling the handoff feeling, the sense that something big is happening, and I want to explore that further.
